parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button part of a retractable pen, made of plastic and located at the top end of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, controlling the writing mechanism inside.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and released, engaging an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body of the pen, made of plastic, which houses the ink cartridge and provides grip for writing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the structural frame of the pen, holding internal components and providing a surface for the user to grasp while writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing stability and support for the writing mechanism.
